fire.name: Flame Gout
fire.desc: Short gout of flame. Sets targets burning.

water.name: Torrent
water.desc: Pressure jet — shoves enemies back and soaks them.

ice.name: Ice Shards
ice.desc: Three fast shards. Three chill stacks freeze.

lightning.name: Arc
lightning.desc: Instant arc, jumps to two more. Double on wet targets.

earth.name: Hurled Stone
earth.desc: Heavy rock. Shatters frozen enemies for double.

arcane.name: Arcane Bolt
arcane.desc: Fast bolt of raw energy that pierces one target.

earth+earth.name: Stone Rampart
earth+earth.desc: Stone wall. Blocks enemies and their shots; yours pass.

fire+lightning.name: Thunderflare
fire+lightning.desc: Explosive bolt. Do not fire it point-blank.

ice+water.name: Hoarfrost Field
ice+water.desc: Freezes everything inside it — you included.

earth+fire.name: Molten Core
earth+fire.desc: Molten boulder that leaves burning ground.

lightning+water.name: Storm Pool
lightning+water.desc: Electrified pool. Shocks anyone standing in it.

earth+ice.name: Rime Bulwark
earth+ice.desc: Ice wall that chills attackers. Fire melts it.

arcane+fire.name: Hexfire Comet
arcane+fire.desc: Arcane fireball with a wide magical blast.

arcane+earth.name: Runestone
arcane+earth.desc: Rune-charged boulder that detonates on impact.

arcane+ice.name: Prism Lances
arcane+ice.desc: Five piercing lances in a fan.

arcane+lightning.name: Ley Arc
arcane+lightning.desc: Long chain that jumps through five enemies.

arcane+water.name: Undertow
arcane+water.desc: Vortex that drags enemies to its centre.

fire+water.name: Scalding Steam
fire+water.desc: Steam cone — heavy damage, no burn.

earth+water.name: Mudslide
earth+water.desc: Mud wave — huge knockback, mires enemies.

earth+lightning.name: Lodestone
earth+lightning.desc: Boulder that discharges into three nearby enemies.

ice+lightning.name: Rime Arc
ice+lightning.desc: Chain that chills every target it jumps through.

arcane+fire+lightning.name: Starfall
arcane+fire+lightning.desc: Marks the ground; a star lands a second later.

nature.name: Bramble Lash
nature.desc: Thorned lash that roots what it catches.

wind.name: Gust
wind.desc: A shove of air. Fans flames, chills the wet.

light.name: Sunbeam
light.desc: A thin ray of light that blinds everything along it.

dark.name: Shadow Bolt
dark.desc: Curses its target and drains a little life back to you.

fire+fire.name: Supernova
fire+fire.desc: A sun drops where you aim, then leaves a sea of fire.

water+water.name: Tsunami
water+water.desc: A wall of water that sweeps the court clear.

ice+ice.name: Glacier Prison
ice+ice.desc: Permafrost erupts and encases everything inside.

lightning+lightning.name: Thunderstorm
lightning+lightning.desc: A storm cell that strikes anyone below it, you included.

nature+nature.name: World Tree
nature+nature.desc: Yggdrasil's sprout: roots your foes, heals you while you stand under it.

wind+wind.name: Cyclone
wind+wind.desc: A spinning column that drags the horde together.

light+light.name: Divine Judgement
light+light.desc: A holy lance across the whole court.

dark+dark.name: Black Hole
dark+dark.desc: A singularity that eats enemy shots and drags enemies in.

arcane+arcane.name: Arcane Barrage
arcane+arcane.desc: Seven bolts in a tight fan.

fire+nature.name: Wildfire
fire+nature.desc: Grass bursts up and into flame. Lights the brush.

fire+wind.name: Fire Tornado
fire+wind.desc: A burning vortex that pulls enemies into the flames.

fire+light.name: Solar Flare
fire+light.desc: A coronal flash that burns and blinds.

dark+fire.name: Hellfire
dark+fire.desc: Black flame that ignores every resistance.

nature+water.name: Living Vines
nature+water.desc: Vines burst from the ground and bind whatever stands there.

water+wind.name: Whirlpool
water+wind.desc: A swirling pool that soaks and drags.

light+water.name: Rainbow Mist
light+water.desc: Iridescent mist that heals you and blinds them.

dark+water.name: Abyss Water
dark+water.desc: A torrent from the deep that curses and drains.

earth+nature.name: Forest Fortress
earth+nature.desc: A living wooden wall that heals itself.

earth+wind.name: Sandstorm
earth+wind.desc: Blinding grit: nothing inside can start an attack.

earth+light.name: Crystal Garden
earth+light.desc: Prismatic crystals that throw hexes back at the caster.

dark+earth.name: Graveyard
dark+earth.desc: The ground opens and holds them in their graves.

lightning+nature.name: Static Bramble
lightning+nature.desc: An arc that sprouts thorns around every target.

lightning+wind.name: Tempest
lightning+wind.desc: A long storm arc that leaps through six enemies.

light+lightning.name: Photon Railgun
light+lightning.desc: A light-speed ray through everything in a line.

dark+lightning.name: Void Lightning
dark+lightning.desc: Black lightning: curses and drains each target.

ice+nature.name: Frostbloom
ice+nature.desc: Frozen flowers that root and chill.

ice+wind.name: Blizzard
ice+wind.desc: Driving snow. Freezes soaked enemies outright.

ice+light.name: Aurora Lance
ice+light.desc: A cold, blinding beam of polar light.

dark+ice.name: Black Ice
dark+ice.desc: A slick of cursed ice that mires everything on it.

nature+wind.name: Pollen Gale
nature+wind.desc: A cloud of seeds that roots where it lands.

light+nature.name: Sunbloom
light+nature.desc: Sunlit flowers: heal you, blind them.

dark+nature.name: Death Forest
dark+nature.desc: Cursed woods that drain the life from anything inside.

arcane+nature.name: Wild Magic
arcane+nature.desc: Four seeds of raw magic that root on hit.

dark+wind.name: Shadow Storm
dark+wind.desc: A dark tempest that curses all caught in it.

arcane+light.name: Radiant Orb
arcane+light.desc: A slow sphere of light that bursts and blinds.

fire+lightning+wind.name: Firestorm
fire+lightning+wind.desc: Fire, wind and lightning become one storm. Keep out of it.

earth+fire+lightning.name: Meteor Shower
earth+fire+lightning.desc: Four burning stones fall around the mark.

ice+water+wind.name: Absolute Zero
ice+water+wind.desc: Everything near the mark freezes solid. Everything.

arcane+light+lightning.name: Heaven's Lance
arcane+light+lightning.desc: The sky opens in a line.

arcane+dark+water.name: Maelstrom
arcane+dark+water.desc: A whirlpool into the void. Swallows shots.

light+nature+water.name: World Bloom
light+nature+water.desc: The court flowers: a long, strong heal for you.

earth+nature+water.name: Ancient Grove
earth+nature+water.desc: A line of old trees that keeps growing back.

dark+earth+nature.name: Necropolis
dark+earth+nature.desc: The dead rise and drag the living down.

fire+nature+wind.name: Inferno Gale
fire+nature+wind.desc: A wildfire carried on the wind.

dark+lightning+wind.name: Night Tempest
dark+lightning+wind.desc: A cursed storm arc through eight enemies.
